ORDER The relief sought for in the present writ petition is to direct the first respondent to withdraw the Notification dated 03.07.2019 issued under Section 3(2) of the Tamil Nadu Acquisition Land for Industrial Purposes Act, 1997 in so far as petitioner property situated in T.S.No.C/1/2/5 measuring to an extent of 95 cents in Patta No.58, Chikkadasampalayam Village, Mettupalayam Taluk,
Coimbatore District and property in S.F.No.13/34 now T.S.No.A/4/69 measuring to an extent of 58 cents in Patta 2, Odandurai Village and initiate acquisition proceedings under the https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition Rehabilitation and Settlement Act, 2014.
2.
It is not in dispute that the land acquisition proceedings are in progress.
The relief as such sought for in the present writ petition to withdraw the Notification dated 03.07.2019 would not arise on account of the fact that the proceedings are in progress.
3. The learned counsel for the petitioner made a submission that the compensation is to be determined based on the New Land Acquisition Act of the year 2013.
